title: Restricted completion reduction is an isomorphism
statement: After applying adicDerivedRestrict to the quotient coefficient ring, the morphism adicCompletionReduction is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Choose finite generators and apply koszulQuotientLimit with its unit compatibility. Choose a K-flat model of the Koszul completion and apply the perfect scalar comparison. The images of the generators in Λ/I^(n+1) have (n+1)-st powers zero, by membership in the ideal power.

The nilpotent Koszul unit is an isomorphism. Its scalar comparison square shows that reduction of the original Koszul unit is an isomorphism. Reduction respects composition and carries the Koszul-to-quotient-completion comparison isomorphism to an isomorphism. Consequently reduction of adicCompletionMap is an isomorphism.

Apply the scalar Hom equivalence to the composite of reduction of the completion map and the evaluation adjoint. Its unit formula and adicCompletionMap_projection identify this composite with identity. Since its first factor is invertible, the evaluation adjoint is invertible; exact restriction preserves this isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem adicCompletionReduction_restricted_isIso (X : Scheme.{t}) {Λ : Type t} [CommRing Λ] (d : CompleteCoefficientDatum Λ) {K : proEtaleDerivedCategory X Λ} (M : AdicKFlatModel X Λ K) (N : AdicKFlatModel X Λ (adicCompletionObject X d M)) (n : ℕ) : IsIso ((adicDerivedRestrict X (Ideal.Quotient.mk (d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))).map (adicCompletionReduction X d M N n))
